location: Australia-wide offices including Mildura VIC; Adelaide head office
subject: Graduate Development Program enquiry, Marc Darenz Masarate
email_body:
Hello Saumya,

I am writing about Tonkin's Graduate Development Program. Your graduate program page asks interested graduates to contact you, and I wanted to reach you directly.

In February 2026 I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design with road, earthworks, pavement and stormwater design in Civil 3D and AutoCAD. I also hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering from the Philippines (2019). From 2019 to 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines as field engineer and project-in-charge.

I am Melton based, hold a White Card, an Australian driver's licence and own transport, and have full working rights until December 2027 on a Subclass 485 visa. I am available for site, regional and FIFO work, and I am open to discussing relocation for the right Tonkin office, including Mildura.

Your two-year path for recent civil engineering and drafting graduates, with structured workshops in year one, is the consultancy graduate structure I am seeking. I do not yet have Australian consultancy employment, so I am looking for mentoring on live project work.

I have attached my resume and cover letter. Portfolio: https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio

Kind regards,
Marc Darenz Masarate
0478 764 077
macdarenz@gmail.com
https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio
